lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਹਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sunahi vakhaanahi jetaRe hau tin balihaarai jaau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who hear and chant the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਖੀਵਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਏ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: taa man kheevaa jaaneeai jaa mahalee paae thaau ||2||
lines.translation: Only one who obtains a room in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is deemed to be truly intoxicated. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਨੀਰੁ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਸਤੁ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਤਨਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naau neer cha(n)giaaeeaa sat paramal tan vaas ||
lines.translation: Bathe in the waters of Goodness and apply the scented oil of Truth to your body,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਜਲਾ ਲਖ ਦਾਤੀ ਇਕ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa mukh hovai ujalaa lakh daatee ik daat ||
lines.translation: and your face shall become radiant. This is the gift of 100,000 gifts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਹਿ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਸੂਖ ਜਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dookh tisai pahi aakheeahi sookh jisai hee paas ||3||
lines.translation: Tell your troubles to the One who is the Source of all comfort. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: so kiu manahu visaareeai jaa ke jee paraan ||
lines.translation: How can you forget the One who created your soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis vin sabh apavitr hai jetaa painan khaan ||
lines.translation: Without Him, all that we wear and eat is impure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਿ ਗਲਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: hor galaa(n) sabh kooReeaa tudh bhaavai paravaan ||4||5||
lines.translation: Everything else is false. Whatever pleases Your Will is acceptable. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahal 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਲਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਘਸਿ ਮਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਤਿ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaal mohu ghas mas kar mat kaagad kar saar ||
lines.translation: Burn emotional attachment, and grind it into ink. Transform your intelligence into the purest of paper.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਕਲਮ ਕਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਛਿ ਲਿਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaau kalam kar chit lekhaaree gur puchh likh beechaar ||
lines.translation: Make the love of the Lord your pen, and let your consciousness be the scribe. Then, seek the Guru's Instructions, and record these deliberations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਿਖੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਲਿਖੁ ਲਿਖੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: likh naam saalaah likh likh a(n)t na paaraavaar ||1||
lines.translation: Write the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; write over and over again that He has no end or limitation. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਏਹੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa ehu lekhaa likh jaan ||
lines.translation: O Baba, write such an account,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਹੋਇ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jithai lekhaa ma(n)geeai tithai hoi sachaa neesaan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: that when it is asked for, it will bring the Mark of Truth. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਸਦ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਸਦ ਚਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jithai milahi vadiaaeeaa sad khuseeaa sad chaau ||
lines.translation: There, where greatness, eternal peace and everlasting joy are bestowed,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਟਿਕੇ ਨਿਕਲਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin mukh tike nikalahi jin man sachaa naau ||
lines.translation: the faces of those whose minds are attuned to the True Name are anointed with the Mark of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਗਲੀ ਵਾਉ ਦੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: karam milai taa paaeeai naahee galee vaau duaau ||2||
lines.translation: If one receives God's Grace, then such honors are received, and not by mere words. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਰਖੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਵ ਸਲਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik aavahi ik jaahi uth rakheeahi naav salaar ||
lines.translation: Some come, and some arise and depart. They give themselves lofty names.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਵਡੇ ਦਰਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik upaae ma(n)gate ikanaa vade daravaar ||
lines.translation: Some are born beggars, and some hold vast courts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: agai gaiaa jaaneeai vin naavai vekaar ||3||
lines.translation: Going to the world hereafter, everyone shall realize that without the Name, it is all useless. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਡਰੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਛਿਜੈ ਦੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai terai dar agalaa khap khap chhijai deh ||
lines.translation: I am terrified by the Fear of You, God. Bothered and bewildered, my body is wasting away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਵ ਜਿਨਾ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਹੋਦੇ ਡਿਠੇ ਖੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: naav jinaa sulataan khaan hode dithe kheh ||
lines.translation: Those who are known as sultans and emperors shall be reduced to dust in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਕੂੜੇ ਤੁਟੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak uthee chaliaa sabh kooRe tute neh ||4||6||
lines.translation: O Nanak, arising and departing, all false attachments are cut away. ||4||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਮਿਠੇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਾਲੋਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ras mithe ma(n)niai suniai saalone ||
lines.translation: Believing, all tastes are sweet. Hearing, the salty flavors are tasted;

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਟ ਤੁਰਸੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਮਾਰਣ ਨਾਦ ਕੀਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: khat turasee mukh bolanaa maaran naad keee ||
lines.translation: chanting with one's mouth, the spicy flavors are savored. All these spices have been made from the Sound-current of the Naad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਾਉ ਏਕੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: chhateeh a(n)mrit bhaau ek jaa kau nadar karei ||1||
lines.translation: The thirty-six flavors of ambrosial nectar are in the Love of the One Lord; they are tasted only by one who is blessed by His Glance of Grace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa hor khaanaa khusee khuaar ||
lines.translation: O Baba, the pleasures of other foods are false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit khaadhai tan peeReeai man mahi chalahi vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Eating them, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਸੁਪੇਦੀ ਸਤੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: rataa painan man rataa supedee sat daan ||
lines.translation: My mind is imbued with the Lord's Love; it is dyed a deep crimson. Truth and charity are my white clothes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਲੀ ਸਿਆਹੀ ਕਦਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਪਹਿਰਣੁ ਪੈਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: neelee siaahee kadaa karanee pahiran pair dhiaan ||
lines.translation: Erasing the blackness of sin is my wearing of blue clothes, and meditation on the Lord's Lotus Feet is my robe of honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਮਰਬੰਦੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kamaraba(n)d sa(n)tokh kaa dhan joban teraa naam ||2||
lines.translation: Contentment is my cummerbund, Your Name is my wealth and youth. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa hor painan khusee khuaar ||
lines.translation: O Baba, the pleasures of other clothes are false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਪੈਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit paidhai tan peeReeai man mahi chalahi vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Wearing them, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘੋੜੇ ਪਾਖਰ ਸੁਇਨੇ ਸਾਖਤਿ ਬੂਝਣੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਾਟ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghoRe paakhar suine saakhat boojhan teree vaat ||
lines.translation: The understanding of Your Way, Lord, is horses, saddles and bags of gold for me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਰਕਸ ਤੀਰ ਕਮਾਣ ਸਾਂਗ ਤੇਗਬੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tarakas teer kamaan saa(n)g tegaba(n)d gun dhaat ||
lines.translation: The pursuit of virtue is my bow and arrow, my quiver, sword and scabbard.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਜਾ ਨੇਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: vaajaa nejaa pat siu paragat karam teraa meree jaat ||3||
lines.translation: To be distinguished with honor is my drum and banner. Your Mercy is my social status. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਚੜਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa hor chaRanaa khusee khuaar ||
lines.translation: O Baba, the pleasures of other rides are false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਚੜਿਐ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit chaRiai tan peeReeai man mahi chalahi vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By such rides, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਖੁਸੀ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar ma(n)dar khusee naam kee nadar teree paravaar ||
lines.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the pleasure of houses and mansions. Your Glance of Grace is my family, Lord.
